_comment: Maps AS400 screen values onto the Laserfiche AP template. Left side = Laserfiche field name (must match the template exactly). Right side = AS400 keys from the AS400 Bridge capture, first non-empty wins ('a|b'). Lists (apSubGlNum) fill multi-value fields, or are joined with commas for single-value fields. Dates M/D/YYYY are converted for Date fields automatically.
